title: Paws & Nooks
description:
Cats and dogs napping in the coziest places: crackling fireplaces, snowy cabins, rainy windows and sunny nooks. Each nap comes with calm, original music to help you sleep, study or slow down.

Every video is a long, gentle nap. No sudden sounds, no loud moments, just soft piano and a sleepy friend.

Subscribe and nap along. 🐾
